item.title: Nevada sues Kalshi as federal regulators say back off
item.description: Nevada officials sued Kalshi, calling it an illegal betting website. The same day, a top Trump finance regulator said states should butt out.

item.title: Perplexity says it's moving away from ads and betting on subscriptions
item.description: Perplexity, a San Francisco-based AI startup, emphasizes subscriptions and business sales, diverging from OpenAI's ad-centric approach.

item.title: OpenClaw creator slams Europe's regulations as he moves to the US
item.description: Peter Steinberger, creator of OpenClaw, is moving to OpenAI in the US, citing Europe's strict regulations as a hurdle for tech growth.

item.title: I worked closely with Rev. Jesse Jackson after he took a chance on me at age 19. Here's what he taught me about leadership.

item.title: I'm an Amazon tech lead who uses AI to write code daily. There's one situation I hesitate to use it in.
item.description: Anni Chen says vibe coding is hard to resist. It speeds up her productivity, but she doesn't trust it blindly.

item.title: I couldn't find the kind of community I wanted as a digital nomad — so I built it in Bali

item.title: I built my career in Japan as an American. I learned there's one thing that's non-negotiable.

item.title: Ducati's North America CEO said he hopes self-driving motorcycles never become a thing
item.description: Ducati's North America CEO Jason Chinnock said Ducati builds motorcycles for the thrill of the ride, not just to get from point A to point B.

item.title: The EU is investigating Shein for its 'addictive,' gamified service
item.description: Shein's gamified service, which uses points and rewards to drive engagement, jeopardizes consumer well-being, the EU said.
